title: CCC Intelligent Solutions Adds Azimuth to Diagnostics Network
summary: CCC integrates Azimuth Claims Solutions with CCC ONE, bringing ADAS calibration recommendations and labor times directly into collision repair workflows.
body_markdown:
‍ **About CCC Intelligent Solutions** CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: CCC) is a leading SaaS and AI platform powering the multi-trillion-dollar insurance and repair economy. CCC connects more than 35,000 businesses, including insurers, repairers, automakers and parts suppliers, through the workflows where claims and repair decisions are made every day. With AI built into those workflows for over a decade and informed by more than 40 years of industry data, CCC helps customers manage growing complexity and move work forward with confidence. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its network, CCC helps keep people's lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at[www.cccis.com](https://www.cccis.com/) .


**About Azimuth Claims Solutions**
Azimuth Claims Solutions provides the industry’s first integrated ADAS calibration identification and labor time platform, bringing transparency and defensibility to one of the most complex areas of modern collision repair. Our system maps OEM procedures, vehicle build data, and real world time studies into a clear, consistent report aligned with emerging CIECA standards. By delivering software grade accuracy and operational clarity, Azimuth helps insurers, shops, and MSOs streamline the claims process, reduce friction, and ensure safe, compliant repairs. For more information, visit[www.azimuthclaims.com](https://www.azimuthclaims.com/) .
